sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kw frequency converter.
Our latest forecast for part:350020 grows +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, volume, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,580 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We appreciate your updated volume forecast and your willingness to accelerate payment in exchange for a more favorable price.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown in a separate communication.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €428.26 per unit.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
